name: Shekati
subtitle: Check tracker
description:
Record incoming and outgoing checks, see their due dates and keep your check images together.

The free plan includes one bank account, ten active checks, manual entry, a calendar and reminders.

Shekati Plus adds more accounts, unlimited active checks, check scanning, endorsements, partial settlements, replacements and cash flow forecasts.

Choose a monthly or annual subscription. Your local price is shown before purchase. Subscriptions renew automatically until canceled in your Apple Account.

You can read, close and export existing checks after a subscription ends.
